priorityList: Use offensive cooldowns (Trinkets, Racials, and Potions) when Coordinated Assault is active or ready to be cast.
Cast Kill Command if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear and any Howl of the Pack Leader buff (Wyvern, Boar, or Bear) is active.
Cast Kill Command if Coordinated Assault is about to come off cooldown and you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Coordinated Assault (Takedown) on cooldown, ideally with at least 1 stack of Tip of the Spear (unless using Twin Fangs).
Cast Boomstick whenever you have a stack of Tip of the Spear active.
Cast Wildfire Bomb if you have Tip of the Spear active and need to extend the duration of Fury of the Wyvern.
Cast Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if Tip of the Spear is active or if the Raptor Swipe buff is missing.
Cast Kill Command whenever Coordinated Assault is on cooldown to generate Focus and Tip of the Spear stacks.
Cast Wildfire Bomb as a filler if you have charges available and Tip of the Spear is active.
Use Aspect of the Eagle if you are forced out of melee range to continue attacking.
